   OR op.grant_id IS NOT NULL OR op.grant_revision IS NOT NULL OR op.permission IS NOT NULL OR op.state IS NOT NULL
SELECT *                FROM public.command_principal p WHERE p.organization_id=p_organization_id AND p.principal_id=p_principal_id

NOT FOUND OR principal.mercado_livre_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_mercado_livre_connection_id
   OR principal.omie_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_omie_connection_id OR principal.reason IS DISTINCT FROM p_reason
   OR principal.provenance IS DISTINCT FROM p_provenance OR principal.correlation_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_correlation_id
   OR principal.decided_at IS DISTINCT FROM op.decided_at
SELECT *        FROM public.s2a_accepted_attestation x WHERE x.organization_id=p_organization_id AND x.manifest_id=p_manifest_id

NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.s2a_attestation_consumption c
    WHERE c.organization_id=p_organization_id AND c.manifest_id=p_manifest_id AND c.principal_id=p_principal_id
      AND c.manifest_digest=a.manifest_digest AND c.correlation_id=p_correlation_id AND c.consumed_at=op.decided_at)
op.intent_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM computed_intent OR op.receipt_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM computed_receipt
